train_model: train a graph neural network to predict particle mobilities in glasses using JAX and Jraph
make_graph_from_static_structure: build a Jraph graph from particle positions, types, and box dimensions with periodic boundary conditions
get_targets: compute averaged particle mobilities from initial and trajectory target positions across sampled trajectories
load_data: load simulation data files into graphs, targets, and masks for training or testing a GNN model
apply_random_rotation: apply a random O(3) rotation with pi/2 multiples and reflections to a graph for data augmentation
